_cities_comment: World clocks as [label, IANA timezone] pairs. A row may also be [label, zone, latitude, longitude]; those two numbers opt that city into its own current-conditions glyph, and nothing else does — the label and the timezone are never looked up. The search list writes pairs, so coordinates are added by editing the row. A zone the database does not know is dropped without a word. The order here is ignored — the pane sorts west to east by each zone's current offset, with the label breaking ties, so the rows read as a map.
_weather_latitude_comment: Latitude, in degrees from -90 to 90, of the one place whose current weather is shown. Null leaves weather off. Zero is the equator, so it is a real place once you set it — an unset field stays null rather than zero. Set longitude as well; one without the other is reported on the pane and not fetched.
_weather_longitude_comment: Longitude, in degrees from -180 to 180, of that same place. Null leaves weather off. The widget does not guess a coordinate from a city name or from the machine.
_weather_label_comment: Optional name drawn beside the temperature. Empty shows the conditions without a place name. The coordinates are what is fetched; this text is only a label.
_work_start_hour_comment: Local 24-hour clock hour when the work day begins.
_work_end_hour_comment: Local 24-hour clock hour when the work day ends.
_show_hints_comment: Whether the pomodoro key hints sit under the panel. Visible by default: the hints are how the keys are found in the first place, and starting hidden means a reader has to already know the key that reveals them. [?] toggles it live.
_work_days_comment: Which days count as working days, as names (sun, mon, ...) or numbers. Drives the working-day shading.
_pomodoro_enabled_comment: Whether the pomodoro starts enabled when clocks launches.
_pomodoro_sessions_before_long_break_com: Completed focus sessions before a long break.
_pomodoro_bell_comment: Whether a terminal bell sounds when a phase ends.
_pomodoro_notify_comment: Whether a desktop notification is attempted when a phase ends.
_pomodoro_flash_comment: Whether the pane flashes when a phase ends.
_pomodoro_flash_rgb_comment: Flash colour as three red, green, blue values.
